project_type: Python CLI automation bot using Playwright for browser automation on Naukri.com job applications
build_system: setuptools via pyproject.toml, editable install with pip install -e '.[dev]'
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio, using unittest.mock for mocking Playwright objects. Tests in tests/ directory with conftest.py fixtures.
verification_instructions: 1. Install package in editable mode: pip install -e '.[dev]'. 2. Run pytest tests/ -v and confirm all tests pass. 3. Verify new modules import correctly with: python -c 'from naukri_apply.llm_agent import LLMAgent; from naukri_apply.direct_apply import DirectApplyHandler'
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full network access available. groq pip package needs to be installed. Virtual env at .venv already exists with base deps.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns: async/await for browser operations, Pydantic models, Click CLI, YAML config with env var overrides. Tests use unittest.mock with AsyncMock for Playwright.
key_patterns: 1. All browser handlers are async classes with Page+Config constructor pattern. 2. form_filler.py provides shared utilities (find_field, fill_text_field, etc). 3. Config loads from YAML with env var overrides via python-dotenv. 4. Models use Pydantic BaseModel. 5. CSVLogger appends results in real-time. 6. Tests mock Playwright Page/Locator objects extensively with MagicMock/AsyncMock. 7. Module lives in src/naukri_apply/ package.
directory_structure: src/naukri_apply/ - main package with all modules. tests/ - pytest test files mirroring source modules. Root has pyproject.toml, config.example.yaml, .env.example, README.md.
